66fd559e7358e278a71e1236.text:
Give Copilot Studio owners visibility of shared environment credits

Copilot Studio agent owners can see their own agent's consumption, but shared environment credit allocation and other agents' use are normally available only to admins. A custom view should show makers their eligible environments, usage against each allocation, daily consumption and per-agent billed credits.

e9595911a09f620889303ada.text:
Use Cloud PC pools as a governed runtime for Computer Use

Microsoft Copilot Studio Computer Use can run on Cloud PC pools, Microsoft hosted Windows 11 Cloud PCs that are Entra ID joined and Intune enrolled. This enables single sign on to internal systems, policy enforcement, security configuration and compliance controls, unlike the unmanaged hosted browser runtime.

Source: The Custom Engine

2f86687dce48bf8ab640fbd2.text:
Govern a Generic Custom Connector Before Sharing It

A Custom Connector can store an API key on one encrypted connection and expose generic actions that receive relativePath, query and body at runtime. DLP applies to the whole connector, so a connector capable of reaching any REST API should be governed before productive sharing.

Source: PowerPlatformTip

c300889910a697c434c2f9f3.text:
Connect Microsoft Foundry agents securely in Copilot Studio

Copilot Studio connects an Azure AI Foundry agent by using its agent name and endpoint URL, selecting Connect to an external agent, choosing Microsoft Foundry, authenticating through Microsoft Entra ID, and submitting the endpoint. Foundry traces then expose inputs, outputs, IDs, and completion timestamps.

Source: The Custom Engine

387ef015d855ffe39d75d3e4.text:
Design a scalable Dataverse model with ownership and controlled change

Build D365 CE data models around business concepts, then use standard Dataverse tables where they fit and custom components only for clear needs. Define relationship behaviour, data owners, system-of-record rules, stable integration identifiers, and conflict handling. Document the model, test realistic queries and updates, and deploy changes through solutions across development, test, and production environments.

Source: Softchief Technologies

b4c5acf47a3089a3d862cd8a.text:
What Purview DLP Really Controls in Copilot

Microsoft Purview DLP uses separate controls for Microsoft 365 Copilot: it can stop external web search, block sensitive prompts, exclude labeled files or emails, and reject external email sources. It does not repair permissions or inspect directly uploaded files for Sensitive Information Types through this policy location.

Source: MVPTreff

One SDK Client for Both Copilot Studio Harnesses

The Copilot Studio client uses the same conversation methods for standard and GitHub Copilot harnesses when given an environment ID and agent schema name. JavaScript and .NET support is available, while Python support is planned. GitHub Copilot harness support remains preview, with endpoints rolling out across regions.
